cases.summary: Urgent GI biopsy received and cut up Monday; loaded onto Processor B for the Monday overnight run. Embedded from 07:00 Tuesday; first urgent case at microtomy at 07:45. Three levels were stained, scanned and passed IQC; ready for pathologist handoff at 09:30, before the noon operational target.
BCSP-linked bowel polyp biopsy; embedded and waiting in the microtomy queue. Show lab-preparation handoff estimate only, not the programme reporting deadline.
Cervical-screening biopsy; three required levels are cut. Show lab-preparation handoff estimate only, not the programme reporting deadline.
Blocks A1-E1 are in the Processor D large-specimen processor, with output expected 12:00-13:00. Block F1 still awaits pathologist cut-up; the full case cannot be handed off until F1 is completed.
GI biopsy protocol requires levels 1-3; only level 1 was cut at microtome station 4 at 10:40. Staff review is required before the case advances.
Original H&E basket failed at 10:45. Team notified; troubleshooting underway; repeat staining is in progress. This case has two linked slides in H&E-BASKET-01.
